paper_verdict.estimator_family: IV-GMM (robust), instruments are first and second lags of investment; cross-sectional-style pooled IV by income group, not dynamic-panel GMM
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Log-log elasticities of GDP per capita level (labelled 'economic growth'); ICT headline is a group-specific PCA index with non-comparable scale; authors read elasticities as percent changes; MIC pools upper and lower middle; component (mobile/internet/fbb) and index estimates come from the same samples, so they are not independent; no fixed effects stated; instruments questionable.
